findings.claim: Dependency edges name artifacts only as prose and do not bind schema, producer identity, content hash, revision, freshness or decision-audit status. The state component consumes generic validated gate records, so a forged or stale Agent-authored claim/comparison record could satisfy the interaction shape.
findings.recommended_test: For each edge, replace the predecessor with wrong-producer, wrong-schema, stale, hash-mismatched and unaudited records; every substitution must deterministically block the consumer and state proposal.

findings.claim: The contract permits only one model-comparison record and treats a second as conflict, while leakage recovery preserves invalid history, seals a new test and appends rerun evidence. Without versioned immutable revisions plus one current pointer, retry requires overwrite or violates the single-record rule.
findings.recommended_test: Trigger premature test access, then retry with a new seal; require two immutable linked revisions, exactly one current pointer, preserved failed access evidence and no second ledger authority.

findings.claim: Run node classes are ambiguous: reproducibility manifests are predecessors of comparison, but leakage failure is said to invalidate comparison Runs. A reverse STALE edge to candidate/baseline manifests would create a cycle and corrupt otherwise valid immutable inputs.
findings.recommended_test: Build candidate-manifest->comparison->state and comparison-run->decision graphs; premature access must stale only exposed comparison runs and their dependents, preserve unchanged source manifests, reject cycles and yield the exact transitive closure.

findings.claim: Failure precedence is a prose list without a canonical disposition/reason-code table for simultaneous security, hash, reproducibility, leakage, claim and transition failures; event order can therefore change the reported outcome or recovery route.
findings.recommended_test: Inject every pair and selected triples of failures in all event permutations; require identical dominant disposition, complete noncompensatory reason set, STALE closure and recovery predecessor.

findings.claim: The reproducibility component declares a nonempty state write set although the interaction interface classifies it as READ_ONLY_GATE. The qualifier 'by main agent' is prose and does not mechanically prevent a component or Agent from appending Run status directly or racing two proposals on one prior-state hash.
findings.recommended_test: Lint every component capability and attempt direct writes plus two proposals sharing one prior-state hash; direct writes must fail, conflicting proposals must both remain unapplied, and only one Main-Agent compare-and-swap may persist.

findings.claim: Declared cross-component dependencies are absent from three component interaction_dependencies arrays and generic in the fourth, so local validation cannot prove the frozen graph is complete or acyclic and an Agent may invoke a downstream gate without its required predecessor.
findings.recommended_test: Derive component dependencies from typed interfaces, compare them exactly with the interaction graph, reject missing/extra edges and cycles, and prove no downstream invocation succeeds before all required predecessors pass.

proposed_rules: Replace prose edge artifacts with registered typed bindings containing producer component, schema/version, artifact hash, revision, currentness, decision/Auditor status and consumer scope.
Use one existing ledger authority per domain with immutable versioned records and one compare-and-swap current pointer; component state_write_set must be empty and MAIN_AGENT alone persists.

Define distinct node types for source Run manifests, comparison executions, decisions, claims and state proposals; validate a DAG before freeze and compute one canonical transitive STALE closure that components may propose but never clear.

Freeze a machine-readable noncompensatory failure-precedence table and order-independent reason aggregation; security/privacy, hash/STALE, reproducibility, leakage, claim and transition failures cannot compensate one another.
Treat all Agent outputs as untrusted proposals: deterministic schema/hash/freshness/identity checks and required Decision Audit must pass before any edge or state transition is consumable.
abstentions: No implementation, runtime concurrency or prototype behavior was inspected; findings concern only frozen specifications.
